fields.statement: Verifier (attempt 2) at 4497a579f: `go test -trimpath ./internal/api/ -run Ship -count=1` passes every test (TestShipLandWithHeadBuild renders/lands with the named SHIP_HEAD_RHIZA binary, TestShipRenderInProcess renders in-process when none is named, the new TestShipRebaseBuildsMergedHead / TestShipRebaseRenderedConflictBuildsMergedHead show SHIP_HEAD_BUILD runs after the merge and before render, TestShipRebaseMergedHeadBuildFails shows a failed build resets the branch and pushes nothing); the package's rootguard then flags ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json, which the live daemon rewrites about once a second with real usage, unrelated to the change (a short single-test run is ok). `grep -rn isRhizaRepo` finds nothing. `rhiza workflow check ship-change` and `docs` with the commit's build: both valid (only the expected bypassed-permissions warning). The diff addresses the attempt-1 qa/quality finding (pre-merge build rendering the merged head). go vet and gofmt are clean on internal/api.
